title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 09:00 UTC on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日 09:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp = 0.00 (label 0Z) at 09:00 UTC. The 09:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 09:59; end-of-hour 0.00/0Z). 10:00 UTC is a trailing incomplete hour (57 samples to 10:56), so it is not used. Last-180 maximum 0.33 first at 07:57 UTC on 21 September (label 0P; last-180 window from 07:57 UTC). Published-window maximum 1.00 (04:59 UTC, label 1Z). Window start 04:59 UTC on 21 September (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新可靠整點估計 Kp = 0.00（標籤 0Z；09:00 UTC）。09:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 09:59，時段末 0.00／0Z）。10:00 UTC 為未收滿時段（至 10:56 共 57 筆），故不採用。近 180 筆最大 0.33（最先見於 2026-09-21 07:57 UTC；標籤 0P；近 180 筆窗自 07:57 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.00（04:59 UTC；標籤 1Z）。窗起點 2026-09-21 04:59 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (09:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 09:00 UTC is 0.00/0Z; the trailing 10:00 hour is incomplete (57 samples to 10:56) and unused.

title.en: A magnitude 5.0 earthquake occurred 34 km WNW of Luwuk, Indonesia on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日，印尼 Luwuk 西北西約 34 公里發生規模 5.0 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 5.0, depth about 9.9 km. Newly listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum is mww 5.7 (us7000tit5, south of Africa).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 5.0，深度約 9.9 公里。本輪新上架。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 5.7（us7000tit5，south of Africa）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
